about: P10-D5 v2: Fenrir's Folly rewards for Hunter, Shaman, Spiritmaster and Runemaster from the period Warcry spoiler (Thane, Shadowblade, Bonedancer, Berserker still have no period mapping)

row.Name: Sunstone Essence
row.Description: Target regenerates power regeneration during the duration of the spell.
row.Message1: You feel a calmness come over you.

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem=8490 'Sunstone Essence' (Wayback capture 2003-08-13, period_items.jsonl.gz): Midgard, Jewelry, Dexterity 9, Piety 9, Cold Resist 9%, Heat Resist 9%, Power Regen value 3, Self, 10 min, cast 3.00 s, Default Bonus 35%, Weight 1.00 lbs, Level to Attain 50, from The Legend of Fenrir's Folly; charges from Warcry spoiler 1161 (Wayback 2004-10-28): '5 charges of power regen'
entries.why: the charge spell of the period Sunstone Essence (Power Regen 3, self, 10 min, 3 s cast); no existing spell has those values (8084 Improved Elixir of Clarity is the same buff with 20 min), so this is 8084 with the period duration

row.Name: Sunstone Essence
row.Description: Classic quest reward (The Legend of Fenrir's Folly)

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem=8490 'Sunstone Essence' (Wayback capture 2003-08-13, period_items.jsonl.gz): Midgard, Jewelry, Dexterity 9, Piety 9, Cold Resist 9%, Heat Resist 9%, Power Regen value 3, Self, 10 min, cast 3.00 s, Default Bonus 35%, Weight 1.00 lbs, Level to Attain 50, from The Legend of Fenrir's Folly; charges from Warcry spoiler 1161 (Wayback 2004-10-28): '5 charges of power regen'
entries.why: the Runemaster/Spiritmaster reward of The Legend of Fenrir's Folly did not exist; built from the period item page (jewel model 118 as the other cq_ jewels; price = the cq_ reward price of a level 50 item, build_resetday165 S10 table)

entries.source: Warcry quest spoiler 1161 'The Legend of Fenrir's Folly' (daoc.warcry.com, Wayback capture 2004-10-28, period-data/archive/wayback-warcry/raw_pages.jsonl.gz): 'Runemaster/Spiritmaster: Sunstone Essence', 'The shaman in our group had the choice between a shield or a jewel. He chose the shield.', 'Hunter got choice between the sword ... and a spear'
entries.why: Shaman (28) gets the Heart of the Sun shield the period Shaman chose; Spiritmaster (27) and Runemaster (29) join the row and receive Sunstone Essence through ClassRewards

entries.source: Warcry quest spoiler 1161 'The Legend of Fenrir's Folly' (daoc.warcry.com, Wayback capture 2004-10-28, period-data/archive/wayback-warcry/raw_pages.jsonl.gz): 'Runemaster/Spiritmaster: Sunstone Essence', 'The shaman in our group had the choice between a shield or a jewel. entries.why: a Spiritmaster or Runemaster finishing The Legend of Fenrir's Folly receives the period Sunstone Essence instead of the Healer's shield
